name: Hand Gesture Controls
description: Control Nuxiva with one or two hands in front of the webcam. The Rust engine recognises poses, held poses, swipes, circles, taps and two-hand gestures; each gesture can run the action you choose from the Hand Gestures app.
capabilities: Pinch to grab and drag widgets, side flick to change screen
12 poses, swipes, circles, tap and double tap
Two-hand gestures: spread, squeeze, rotate, or one hand holds while the other acts
Any gesture can be linked to any action, per context and per hand
Encrypted profile, adjustable sensitivity, JavaScript fallback when the engine is missing

settings.NUXIVA_HOLO_CATALOG: Before creating a 3D model, search online for a ready model and save it in the catalogue
settings.NUXIVA_SKETCHFAB_TOKEN: Sketchfab API token (to download Creative Commons models)
settings.NUXIVA_HOLO_MIN_SCORE: Minimum score (40-95) for a found model to be shown
settings.NUXIVA_HOLO_GENERATE: If no ready model is good enough, generate the 3D model with AI
settings.NUXIVA_HOLO_GPU_URL: Address of the GPU node running Hunyuan3D-2 (local network, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8081)
settings.NUXIVA_HOLO_GPU_TOKEN: GPU node token (optional, when behind a proxy)
settings.NUXIVA_MESHY_TOKEN: Meshy API key for cloud 3D generation (uses credits)
